Before you change where an off-site target copies to, BombVault now tells you whether the new location already holds your backups.

## 🐛 Fixed

- **A moved off-site target always claimed it would receive the whole history.** Changing a target's location, for example to reach the same server over a different VPN route, asked as if everything had to go up again, whether it did or not. BombVault now lists the new location before it asks. If the history is there already, the question says nothing is sent again, and if part of it is, only the missing snapshots are counted. ([#334](https://github.com/junkerderprovinz/bombvault/issues/334))
- **A wrong path at the new location went unnoticed.** If the new location holds no backups at all, the question now says so. In that case the location does not lead to the old repository, and saving it starts uploading everything from scratch.

## 🌐 Translations

- The new texts of the question in all 42 languages.

## Upgrading

- **Nothing has to be changed.** If an off-site copy started over after you changed a location, check that the location leads to the old repository. BombVault only sends what the target is missing, so once the path is right the copy finds the old snapshots and sends nothing again.
